a.text: 'I arrived in this new land from my maritime home. There is no end to ghastly shock here, not a break in the tragic weave.'
'The clouds are far from as fine as told in legend, and both the land and sky are wrathbitten and hurting. Cities comparable to Ægir are all but prey to Catastrophe.'

'Moreover, the people of this dry land are plagued by an inscrutable sickness. I had learnt of Oripathy, of Originium, from many an academy record. Seeing it firsthand, though, the truth of how it has become an integral part of the land, its roots deep and stubborn, is made witheringly apparent.'
'Nevertheless, they still tenaciously live, pursue both technology and truth through their unique means, and seek to leave the mark of their continued existence.'

'Though I am lambasted a traitor, I do not regret my decision to come ashore. The Seaborn swarm is expanding; within a decade, Ægir will find itself besieged with no quarter. But someday, I will complete my travels and return to Iberia.'

'I will leave this memoir behind, for the Ægir to seek and decipher. I have no faith in the nobility; I am certain that those Ægir termed 'Islanders' today will find Iberia withdrawing its respect for them soon enough, whatever the reasons may be.'
'The Golden Dreadnought, the Eye of Culture, the Jurisprudence of Evolution, the Stele of Life. The Ocean and Land must form a united front to withstand the billowing waves.'
'It was never my intent to serve as a pioneer. All I am is one step ahead of fate.'

steps.text: —From a copy of the notes of Breogan, famed Iberian architect and chief shipwright, written in cryptic Ægirian.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: This is a matter between the Ægir.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: So long as you stand on Iberian soil, the law is watching you. And so am I.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: What is the relation between you and those three Abyssal Hunters?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: You've harmed Skadi. Strange. Surely she intended to avoid combat.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Her blood is a special sort, more special than the rest of ours. I hope you've been diligent in cleaning your weapons.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: I'm the one asking questions here.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: And I'm the one who decides whether to answer.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: I gather the only Hunters granted freedom of movement by Lord Carmen were those who declared their interests during the Sal Viento conflict.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: ...Mm. Seems it wasn't a coincidence you crossed swords with her then.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: She was hardly weak.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: ...Weak?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: What a naive appraisal. She's just unaccustomed to dry land. She lacks flexibility.
Don't move, Ægir.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Comply with the High Inquisitor's investigation. The Inquisition has already concluded negotiations with the Hunters. Your every move merely undermines the basis of our cooperation.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: ...Cooperation?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I advise you to rethink your actions.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Inquisitor, how many soldiers like you does Iberia have?

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: That is none of your business.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Enough to amass an army three thousand strong?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Then Iberia is still unqualified.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: You're going nowhere!

steps.name: Sea Terror
steps.text: (Sharp chafing sounds)

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: What? Where did they come from?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: High Inquisitor! Are you alright?

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: I'm fine. That Ægir...

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: This was my fault, sir!

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: He could easily have used that chance to take an arm from me, yet he chose to flee.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: It seems we can't afford to give chase just yet.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: They're headed for the city! They're hiding in the soil!

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: No.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: This entire swathe of earth has been polluted.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: H-How can that be?

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: Take a good look at that gray land, and the sinister miasma filling it.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: Gran Faro is not being infiltrated by the Church of the Deep. It has already fallen to them.

steps.name: High Inquisitor
steps.text: Prepare to fight head-on. Ensure Lord Carmen is safe, ASAP.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: This fluorescent nethersea brand... It's akin to their own city.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: It beggars belief. They're born from it, they proliferate and migrate through it...

steps.name: Sea Terror
steps.text: (Ominous slithering sounds)

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Not all lives thirst for independence. It's no wonder these filthy things were able to hide in this town.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: ...But who brought them ashore?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Welp, this is just perfect. And here we thought we could find a little inspiration on our beach trip. Talk about a total wash.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: (Riffs in agreement)

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: The sea's caressing the land. I can tell. This is bad gone badder.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Kal'tsit once said the Ægir won, and that the Abyssal Hunters are the orphans of that battle. But with how things look now, I'm starting to doubt there was ever a win.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Oh, speaking of Kal'tsit, did she give us the thing?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Way to beat around the bush. Why didn't she just give it straight to that Ægir? Gladiia. That would've been faster.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: (Riffs in doubt)

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: She wanted to use the key to draw us into this. And from that view, she definitely succeeded.

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Or maybe, she was originally planning to make us retrieve or help out with something. And then she changed her mind.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Huh? Hasn't she always been, like, three hundred steps ahead? What could possibly force her to change her mind?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: ...I'm just saying it's possible. Sure, she knows a lot of things, but more than that, she's cautious. If not, how many times would she have died by now?

steps.name: Aya
steps.text: Uh, what are you dancing around for? Dan?

steps.name: Dan
steps.text: This chapel would work great for a concert!

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Skadi, Shark.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: We wiped out every enemy we could see.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: ...Formless wisps of waves are spreading here, as the tide on sandy shores.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: An inauspicious omen. We—We should not be here.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It seems cleaning up some trash wasn't enough to bring her back to her senses.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: What do we do?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Once this area is spotless, we borrow the Iberian's assistance in finding that ship.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: There are things we don't recognize on their bodies.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Perhaps a part of the Sea Terrors themselves.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: ...I've been wondering for a while now.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: How can they still evolve so fast? How are they still so full of life?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Even though we've already...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: That's precisely the question we intend to shed light on. It is also the reason I was willing to cooperate with Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: A fine woman, to be sure.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Rouse yourself, Hunter. End this before the sun sinks below. Sea Terrors who cannot hear the ocean's call are but inferior lifeforms.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You... Gladiia? You've come. I will listen, then.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: ...Shark.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Do you find it unwieldy in your hands?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: This? I often forget the weapon is in my grasp. As if I'm dancing with it.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: That is your past, and it has almost caught up to you.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: We'll be waiting.

steps.name: Sea Terror
steps.text: (Shuddering gargles)

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: You lead a punctual march, Dario. Have you arranged what I asked of you?

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: Yes, Lord.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: The Penal Battalion has readied a ship to leave for the Eye of Iberia. They've also evacuated the coast and surrounded this town by now.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: Those misguided fools have nowhere to flee.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: There's nothing to fear in those petty villains, but the new threat they've brought forth is an astonishing one.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: Our technology is able to treat this much pollution.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Which is only a temporary victory, Dario. And this is 'Ægir technology,' not ours.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: If for every second of every minute, every droplet and every grain of the tides beating against our sandy shores spreads the Sea Terrors and their ecology, how are we to defend our homeland then?

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: We will find an answer before that happens.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Yes, most assuredly.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: The Inquisition is also prepared to do battle with the Abyssal Hunters. We will throttle them to death on this remote shoreline.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: A fitting cemetery. We can only hope they make the wise choice, and that Kal'tsit can accomplish what she's pledged to.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: So this is your apprentice, then. I'm familiar with her from her work.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Y-Yes! Inquisitor Irene, reporting in, Lord Carmen!

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: They say that when Dario found you in the ruins, a thick tome of classics had lodged itself in the beams of the caving roof. A miraculous equilibrium that saved your life.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Young one, you are here only because Dario has determined that you have the will to rush onto the frontline.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: There is an immaturity to you, but you are eager to prove yourself. Your body is filled with vigor and tenacity.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: But your duties in Gran Faro will be no easier than in Sal Viento. From here on, you will only be plunging ever deeper into the heart of evil. Are you prepared?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: For Iberia's orderliness and integrity, I shall raise my sword and my lantern.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: To me, this motto is more than just a rallying cry.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: She will be prepared.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Mm... I trust your judgment, but fate does not often give its people time to prepare.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit and I have matters to attend to still. The mission of guiding the Abyssal Hunters back to the Eye of Iberia is now yours.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: The Eye of Iberia... High Inquisitor, what exactly is our task?

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: ...Establish a camp, safeguard the route, and ensure that our maintenance teams can safely reach the lighthouse.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: The last piece of the Eye of Iberia is fifty nautical miles out from the nearest coast to Gran Faro.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: Assuming, of course, that it's still where the maps indicate.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Fifty nautical miles...

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Once, our fleet could gaze far across the surface of the tranquil sea. But since the Profound Silence, the ocean has become like a boiling poison, melting all who touch it.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: This is a daunting mission. But recapturing this final lighthouse is of tremendous importance to our people.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: U-Understood, sir!

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: It is for this that we require the Ægirs' assistance.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: You are skeptical.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: She has been to see the Inquisition's underground cages.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: So, you have witnessed the truth of the Inquisition's search, in spite of the fact it cannot obtain an answer.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Go, young Inquisitor. Time will not wait. But if necessary, I will have you put time itself on trial.

steps.name: Sea Terror
steps.text: (Pronounced slithering sounds) —!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Watch out!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You okay there?!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I-I'm fine. Sorry, Mr. Elysium, I'm being a drag on us again...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Uh, haha, don't you mind it.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Those Sea Terrors...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Identical wounds, pounded into holes in twos and threes. This style has to be Skadi and the girls.)

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: This town's been wrecked through and through.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Haha... yeah...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Whoa—hold it! Jordi!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Ngah!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Wh-What is this?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: —Fluorescent... creepers? Floating creatures? Or is it... uh, coral?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: This stuff is covering the whole street ahead... Hold on, something's coming out of the roofs—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: —! Move!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Wait, wait—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: —No way, they already have nests here?! I thought the Church of the Deep guys just sicced them on the town!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (And wait, could they seriously have just been born? This many?! How fast does it go?)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Jordi!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Oh, I'm here, I'm here!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Ditch! Take a 180 and run for it!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: But they're behind us too, Mr. Elysium!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: —Ugh, these monsters build nests faster than the freaking undertide gloompincers did—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Then it's do-or-die. Hey, Jordi, find something, anything. You gotta weaponize.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: W-Will an umbrella do?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: ...Yeah, sure looks like we're in for some rain. Hold onto that thing like you mean it!

steps.name: Sea Terror
steps.text: (Pronounced slithering sounds)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: —! Get ready!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Self-satisfied braying)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Burn it all. Together with the buildings.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Delighted hisses)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It would seem Ægir technology isn't necessary to treat the nethersea brand.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Good, you're in one piece. What happened?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...And who is this somewhat despondent-seeming Ægir?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Outstanding strength, Hunters.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Spare us your remarks. Let us hasten to the topic at hand.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Kal'tsit has recently suffered quite the ordeal on your behalf.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The aid she has given us will be forever carved into my memory. While what you've done... I will likewise never forget.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: But this present situation is by her arrangement. A small coastal town, a simple meeting.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Then in honor of her efforts, may we set aside our grievances and begin the discussion?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: What you seek is Breogan's legacy. You want to find the Stultifera.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: (Stultifera Navis, the 'Ship of Fools?' Wasn't that the flagship of the fleet wiped out in the Profound Silence? But how many years has it been?!)

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: What most piques my curiosity is how a foreigner can be so sure that it remains afloat.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Then, from the Iberian point of view, do you believe it to be sunk or not?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: In all likelihood... it isn't.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: However, it has not once returned to port.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: A ship, unsunk for over sixty years, yet never returning to dry land's harbor.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Can your people determine its position?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: We could once. But not now.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: In other words...
Gladiia looks to the statue beside them.
She has no recollection of such buildings. Perhaps they had already died their silent deaths before she came ashore.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: The 'Eye of Iberia.'

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: These wonders were once the cornerstone of a magnificent project, but most of the lighthouses that form the Eye perished in the Profound Silence. Only one remains.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It does not belong to you. It belongs to Ægir.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: ...Breogan was indeed an Ægir, and he came from the ocean, but his devotion was selfless. He made ample contribution to Iberia's sea explorations.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: After the disaster, you let your citizens pour their rage upon the Ægir—upon him. Indulging such folly paints you in an untrustworthy light.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Yet are the Ægir able to swear no implication in the Profound Silence?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Walls will be the death of us all. If the two of you are so determined to continue this conversation, then both Iberia and Ægir are as good as destroyed.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Civilizations do not die, they are merely endlessly replaced. But the next time it happens, humanity will have no hand in it.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, please mind your tongue with Lord Carmen.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: I do not mind; we've certainly known each other long enough. But is this your usual method, Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Surgically extracting the key individuals from the gargantuan body of fate, sitting them down in front of you, and convincing them of the rightness of your idea?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: My idea is simply to save you. Iberia is free to refuse, as is Ægir.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If we count the untested young lady, then there are six at the table: three each for both the Inquisition and the Hunters.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The town square itself is an Iberian marvel constructed by an Ægir. It could not be more appropriate for such a conference.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: At this very moment, the nethersea brand is still spreading. The Sea Terrors have built a nest in town, and their existence takes a vastly different form than before. A difference drastic enough to cause alarm.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If none present yet recognize the scale of this oceanic threat, then perhaps we really should adjourn. We can watch as the precious time bought by the sacrifice of the Abyssal Hunters is whiled away for nothing.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Was our victory... meaningful?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Of course. Without it, then after the Profound Silence, Iberia would not even have a deathbed to struggle upon.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As for you, Lord Carmen, I hope you can put aside your prejudices against the Ægir. Use your—

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: —I'm so very old now, Kal'tsit. Let's get to the point, shall we?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: I've aged past the inclination to win every argument, as well as the strength to uphold glory through speeches.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: There is no greater glory than survival, and no one sees the situation clearer than I. You may rescind your words. The Inquisition is willing to fully cooperate with the Abyssal Hunters in finding the lost dreadnought.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The golden... dreadnought.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I have no objections.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: I would've thought contact between Ægir and Iberia would give you pause.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Contact? Ah... if you could breathe underwater, if you could visit our cities without the aid of equipment, then I would not mind showing you a true display of Ægir's technology.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: We look forward to it, Madame Consul.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: A Tercio of the Penal Battalion will immediately shore several dual-use warships at Gran Faro, establish a camp, and clean up the harbor in preparation.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Dario, Irene, go with the Abyssal Hunters. Prioritize securing a sea route to the Eye of Iberia. Pass your judgment on arrival.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: As you command.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Kal'tsit, should...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Should time be of the essence, I will prioritize reestablishing contact with Ægir.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A voyage to the deep sea is a treacherous affair to us all, but for you, it will simply be a trip back home.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You will find that ship, and you will find a way back to Ægir. I leave the details to your discretion.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Perhaps it will be far in the future when next we meet.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So long as you remember our words. We hope that once you've returned, you will be able to reevaluate all that Ægir has suffered.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Then let us make haste. We will—

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Ah—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Sorry, Dr. Kal'tsit. Uh, ever since the part about the lighthouse, Jordi's been—

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: The Ægir, perfect. I have much to ask you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I... I'm a resident of this town, my name is Jordi.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: There shouldn't be any Ægir in Gran Faro! Our dossier says there are records of collusion between the Ægir and the Church of the Deep!

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: Who are your parents?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: My... my parents were lighthouse technicians. They gave their lives for the Eye of Iberia.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: My house is filled with dusty blueprints, I... I may have never actually seen the lighthouse, but...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I want to. The meaning of my homeland... the meaning of my parents' lifelong struggle... I, uh...

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: You may not. The Inquisition must first interrogate you.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: And why should I consider protecting a feeble civilian in a melee?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What if he were a descendant of Breogan?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: What? But he looks nothing like the photographic records of Breogan.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Even if it's true, we should be demanding he turn over what's left of his family's legacy, and let the Inquisition take over the research.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: High Inquisitor!

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: What is your name, Ægir?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: ...Jordi. Jordi Fontanarossa. My uncle told me that—

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Then you should know what awaits you for voluntarily appearing before the Inquisition.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I... I know.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Irene.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Seize him.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: ...And take him with you.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Yes... Er, what?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: That was what you wished for, was it not?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Thank you, Lord. Nevertheless, my greatest hope is to see true, enduring cooperation between Ægir and Iberia.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Even the longest journey starts with a single step.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Then we don't have a moment to lose. We will let the Eye of Iberia gaze upon the desolate sea once again.
